{{Quote|Master Ropal said the day would come for him to go to the Temple, but not for some time."''<br />''"Master Ropal was unaware of the danger your son is in.|Mahtee Dunn and Cad Bane|audio=TheDayWouldCome-CotF.flac|<ref name="CotF" />}}
'''Wee Dunn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] living with his mother, [[Mahtee Dunn/Legends|Mahtee Dunn]], in [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia's]] [[Kay-Tap square/Legends|Kay-Tap square]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The young Rodian was discovered to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] during his early infancy, but was not to be taken into the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] until a slightly older age. Dunn's identity was entered into a [[Memory crystal/Legends|database]] of [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive [[Youngling/Legends|infants]] stored within the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], which was used to locate future members of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order when the time came for them to be trained. This [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] was eventually [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|stolen]] by the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] at the behest of [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]].

Planning to use the Force-sensitive infants to create an army of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] warriors, Sidious directed Bane to abduct two children from the crystal's list and deliver them to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], where they would become the Dark Lord's test subjects. Dunn was Bane's second target, and the bounty hunter [[Second mission to Rodia/Legends|traveled]] to Kay-Tap square in the guise of a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] in order to fool his mother into willingly handing over the infant. Bane succeeded and took Wee Dunn to Mustafar, where the young Rodian was prepared for [[Conditioning procedure/Legends|brain-washing surgery]]. Before the operation could take place, however, Dunn was [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|rescued]] by Jedi Knight [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. After the ordeal, Dunn was taken into the Jedi Order.

==Biography==
===Targeted===
{{Quote|For your son's protection, I'm going to have to take him now."''<br />''"He is my only child&hellip;|Cad Bane and Mahtee Dunn|audio=HeIsMyOnlyChild-CotF.flac|<ref name="CotF" />}}
[[File:BaneWeeMahtee-CotF.png|thumb|left|250px|Cad Bane attempts to convince Mahtee to surrender Wee.]]
Wee Dunn was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] living on [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]<ref name="CotF" /> around the [[21 BBY/Legends|beginning]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="SW Annual 2011" /> Wee lived with his mother, [[Mahtee Dunn/Legends|Mahtee Dunn]], in [[Kay-Tap square/Legends|Kay-Tap square]], one of Rodia's tropical [[Domed city/Legends|domed]] [[City/Legends|cities]].<ref name="CotF" /> In the days immediately after his birth, Mahtee discovered that her young son was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]]. He was able to levitate toys at this incredibly young age, information that eventually came to the attention of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="TCWCE">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> As a result, the Dunns were visited by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Bolla Ropal/Legends|Bolla Ropal]], who informed Mahtee that although Wee would be taken into the Order, his induction would not occur for some time, as the junior Dunn was still in his early infancy. Despite this, Wee Dunn's name was added to the [[Kyber memory crystal/Legends|Kyber memory crystal]], a [[Memory crystal/Legends|device]] that held the identities of all known [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-sensitive [[Youngling/Legends|children]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="CotF" />

During the Clone Wars, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] put in motion a plan to create an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] warriors that would act as his personal [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] and [[Spy/Legends|spies]]. In order to obtain his initial group of warriors, Sidious hired the notorious [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to steal the Kyber [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] from the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Order and provide Sidious with the information on it.<ref name="CotF" /> Bane complied, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Master Ropal and [[Battle of Devaron/Legends|stripping him]] of the Kyber crystal.<ref name="Cod">{{TCW|Cargo of Doom}}</ref> Sidious then directed Bane to kidnap several of the children listed on the crystal to serve as test subjects for a [[Conditioning procedure/Legends|conditioning procedure]] that would make the children into little more than extensions of his will. Knowing the children listed on the crystal's memory would be in danger, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] decided to look into the Force in hopes that they would be able to [[Force sense/Legends|sense]] the children Bane would target. During the Council's [[Meditation/Legends|meditations]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] discovered that Wee Dunn would be one of the children that would be taken and so [[Second mission to Rodia/Legends|dispatched]] Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] to Rodia.<ref name="CotF" />

On Rodia, Wee and Mahtee Dunn were visited by Cad Bane, who was masquerading as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] that had come to take Wee into the Order. Mahtee was reluctant to surrender her child to Bane, citing her earlier visit from Master Ropal and his claim that Wee would remain with her for quite some time before being taken to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]]. When Mahtee refused to surrender Wee, Bane used a [[Hypnogazer/Legends|hypnogazer]] to force her to give him the child. As Bane left the Dunn house with Wee, Obi-Wan Kenobi arrived and confronted Mahtee. Following the sound of Wee's cries, Kenobi found Bane fleeing to his [[Starship/Legends|ship]], the [[Xanadu Blood/Legends|''Xanadu Blood'']], with the younger Dunn in tow. Although Kenobi gave chase, the bounty hunter escaped Rodia with Wee.<ref name="CotF" />

===Test subject===
{{Quote|There there child, soon you will cry no more."''<br />''"Master, subjects of this age rarely survive the slave conditioning procedure."''<br />''"I'm afraid the risk is necessary. The natural talent these children possess is too great to be wasted by the Jedi. I foresee an army of Force-talented spies in my service, trained in the dark side to peer into every corner of the galaxy from afar. And my enemies will be helpless against such vision. If the surgery fails, I will have lost nothing.|Darth Sidious and RO-Z67|audio=CreepyNannySidious-CotF.flac|<ref name="CotF" />}}
[[File:CreepyNannySidious-CotF.jpg|thumb|right|240px|Darth Sidious watches over Wee Dunn.]]
Wee Dunn was taken by Bane to the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], where Darth Sidious held a [[Darth Sidious's secret facility/Legends|base]] that was built into a mountainside high above a [[Magma/Legends|lava]] flow.<ref name="CotF" /> Dunn was kept within the facility's nursery along with [[Zinn Toa/Legends|Zinn Toa]], a [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] infant that had also been [[Mission to Glee Anselm/Legends|kidnapped]] by Bane.<ref name="Cotf Ep. Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode203.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Children of the Force}}</ref> The two were watched over by a pair of [[Nanny droid/Legends|nanny droids]] in the service of Darth Sidious, who visited the children via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. While Sidious "comforted" a crying Dunn, the Dark Lord was informed by one of his nanny [[Droid/Legends|droids]],<ref name="CotF" /> [[RO-Z67/Legends|RO-Z67]],<ref name="Cotf Ep. Guide" /> that infants such as Dunn and Toa were unlikely to survive the slave conditioning operation. Sidious, who cared little for the safety of the children, decided to go forward with the surgery, claiming that he would lose nothing if Dunn or Toa were killed.<ref name="CotF" />

Jedi Knight [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] had [[Attempted kidnapping of Roo-Roo Page/Legends|captured]] Bane during his attempt to kidnap [[Roo-Roo Page/Legends|yet another child]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. While inspecting the ''Xanadu Blood'' in an attempt to find clues regarding Dunn's whereabouts, Tano and Skywalker discovered evidence that suggested Bane's accomplice in the kidnappings may have been located on Mustafar. This information led the two Jedi to [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|investigate]] the volcanic planet. As they approached Mustafar, Sidious and RO-Z67 were preparing Dunn for his surgery; however, upon learning that their location had been compromised, the holographic [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] ordered that the children be taken to his secondary facility and that the one they now occupied be destroyed. As Sidious ended his transmission, RO-Z67 grabbed Dunn and turned off the base's gravity supports. Neither of the nanny droids could escape with the children before Skywalker and Tano arrived, however, and so they hid in the darkened nursery in the hope that the Jedi would not find them.<ref name="CotF" />

When the Jedi arrived, the droids attacked them, brandishing the children as shields. As Skywalker tried to grab Dunn, the station began to tear itself apart as it fell into the lava flow below. RO-Z67 was hit by falling debris and slid toward an opening in the floor; however, Skywalker was able to use the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|pull]] Dunn to him. Both he and Tano, who had managed to rescue Toa, fled the station and escaped Mustafar in their ship, the [[Twilight/Legends|''Twilight'']].<ref name="CotF" /> Wee was not returned to Mahtee, as the Jedi decided that the children had lived through a traumatic ordeal and were uncertain of the effect that it had had on them. It was instead decided that Dunn was to be raised in the Temple on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Children Ep Commentary" />

==Powers and abilities==
[[File:WeeMahtee-CotF.png|thumb|left|150px|Wee levitates a ball alongside his mother.]]
{{Quote|Your son is strong with the Force. He will make a fine Jedi.|Cad Bane, to Mahtee Dunn|audio=HeWillMakeAFineJedi-CotF.flac|<ref name="CotF" />}}
As an untrained Force-sensitive, Wee Dunn was able to manipulate the Force to a limited extent. In his home in Kay-Tap Square, Dunn was able to levitate a ball; however, this did not come without difficulties, as he dropped it repeatedly. Despite his young age, Darth Sidious sensed that Dunn had great potential in the Force and would some day make a powerful pawn.<ref name="CotF" /> Although his plans for Wee Dunn failed, Sidious eventually saw his vision become [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|reality]], even without the participation of the Rodian child.<ref name="JvS EGtF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Wee Dunn was introduced in the third episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, titled "[[Children of the Force]]." Dunn's name was not mentioned in the episode, but he was given a name in the episode guide.<ref name="Cotf Ep. Guide" /> While the episode itself does not reveal Dunn's fate, both the "Children of the Force" episode commentary,<ref name="Children Ep Commentary" /> and the "Drawing Jedi Younglings" article on [[StarWars.com]] indicate that the Rodian was taken into the Jedi Order in the episode's aftermath.<ref name="Drawing" />
